title: Load balancing: what the balancer sees
description: Hold a routing decision where outstanding counts tie, then compare the balancer’s top-down view of counts with the side view of remaining work.
initialCaption: Advance arrivals; each goes to the lane with fewer outstanding requests.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom
fallback: A fewest-outstanding rule compares only request counts. After four arrivals each lane holds one request, but A has 4 units of remaining work and B has 2; the counts tie, the rule picks A, and Q5 waits behind the larger backlog.
